_source.note: uv run scripts/benchmark-native.py, b4db233, Claw Mini, 2026-10-21; per-request samples omitted

method.cli: New process each sample; 3 warmups warm only OS cache. Wall time includes process startup, resource/style/runtime resolution, Rust rendering, verification and base64 packaging of precompressed Wasm, and HTML write. Static variant omits runtime packaging. Raw wait4 maxRSS is labeled conservatively because of possible inherited parent high-water floor.
method.http: Persistent standard-library HTTP connections to isolated loopback server. Requests contain same inline-data source and scientific style. 20 sequential and 40 requests at 4 clients per workload/encoding. Wire latency includes complete response reception; decode and total latency expose client gzip/JSON cost. Throughput is observed end-to-end client throughput, not maximum server capacity.
method.memory: macOS current process RSS sampled every20ms through psutil7.2.2, with user/system time deltas. Lifetime RSS and IO counters are unavailable and remain null. Sampler overhead included. Darwin wait4 maxRSS bytes are converted to KiB; the Linux VmHWM acceptance gate remains unverified.
method.isolation: Task-local output/store, explicit127.0.0.1 bind, synthetic token used only for local report seeding. No hosted network calls, desktop automation, cache dropping or external publication.

cli.memory_note: Darwin wait4 ru_maxrss is converted from bytes to KiB. Process snapshots expose current RSS, not a lifetime high-water counter. These records do not satisfy the Linux VmHWM gate.

editor.scope: Fresh persistent native editor process per workload, then sequential source previews over real stdin/stdout JSONL. Trusted loopback runtime URL is emitted into HTML only; no server, DNS or HTTP fetch occurs. Includes source resolution, parse/render, response serialization and pipe transfer; JSON decode separate. Excludes real VS Code host, webview load, Wasm init and browser painting.
